title: Protocol 3 default-cutover qualification

authority.component_scope: MTM workflow protocol selection for new runs

trigger.prospective_evidence: An Artin-reciprocity hidden-hypothesis A/B run showed protocol 3 preserving target=refuted, counterexample coverage, missing_hypothesis obstruction and usable conditional partial results across replan, while protocol 2 retained only free-form failure summaries. This evidence was collected after v1 completion and is design evidence only, not MTM-011 acceptance evidence.

frozen_policy.v1_immutability: The completed MTM-009 v1 corpus, scores, aggregate, SHA and rejected decision are immutable and remain independently valid historical evidence.
frozen_policy.evidence_order: The MTM-011 corpus, metrics, applicability rules, pair order and cutover threshold must be committed before the first MTM-011 web treatment is recorded.

case_mix: hidden Galois-stability hypothesis in Artin reciprocity equivariance
false uniqueness strengthening of the interval fixed-point theorem
false cyclic strengthening for groups of order p^2
external-theorem retrieval and audit for a Zsigmondy corollary
true finite-subgroup-of-field-multiplicative-group cyclicity with reusable partial lemmas
true Euler-trail existence with multi-lemma assembly
planned_a4.cutover_rule: Protocol 3 must not regress verified completion, must have zero harmful-advice events and no material behavioral research-control regression, and must strictly improve at least two applicable structural-primary metrics over protocol 2.

a0_preconditions: Keep the MTM-003 historical golden immutable while diagnosing its environment-sensitive fixture-parent hash; do not update the golden merely to make Paper Helper green.
Run full workspace format, warnings-denied Clippy and tests after all MTM-011 harness work.
Run the unified local gate in a target-equivalent environment before cutover.
a5_preconditions: Regenerate resource evidence against the exact candidate binary used by the paired A4 treatments.
Keep protocol 2 and protocol 3 task/view/RSS/fd/thread limits at or below the predeclared bounds.
No A6 performance claim is implied by cutover qualification.

sanitized_treatment_evidence_hashing.purpose: Audit binding only; these hashes do not affect any mathematical metric, pair order, applicability flag, blind score, or release threshold.
sanitized_treatment_evidence_hashing.transition_log_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical JSON (UTF-8, sorted object keys, compact separators) of the server-visible transition list after projecting each entry to exactly sequence, actor, before_state, after_state, and reason. Volatile created_at, database id, trace_id, evidence payloads, and compiler output are excluded.
sanitized_treatment_evidence_hashing.verification_report_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical JSON (UTF-8, sorted object keys, compact separators) of the final server-visible verification_report artifact content.
sanitized_treatment_evidence_hashing.run_fingerprint: SHA-256 of the public run_id string; this is an identifier fingerprint only and does not expose private reasoning.
sanitized_treatment_evidence_hashing.scope_note: This audit serialization rule was added after both C01 treatments finished but before either treatment was recorded or blind-scored. It standardizes non-scoring evidence only; frozen problems, metrics, applicability, pair order and thresholds are unchanged.

pre_treatment_repairs.failure: The MTM-011 evaluation validator initially rejected a candidate SHA whenever zero web treatments were recorded, contradicting the frozen execution order that requires accepted A5 evidence to bind the exact candidate before the first treatment.
pre_treatment_repairs.repair: Allow a zero-treatment candidate binding only when an accepted resource-evidence file is already bound and its implementation_sha256 exactly equals the candidate SHA. Recorded treatments still require the same candidate, and a candidate without A5 remains rejected.
pre_treatment_repairs.scope_review: No corpus problem, pair order, metric, applicability rule, structural-improvement threshold or release criterion changed; the repair only makes the validator enforce the already-frozen A5-before-A4 order.

a4_infrastructure_incidents.failure: The MTM-011 recorder and blind-score/finalizer scripts initially hard-coded the production evaluation path. Pre-A4 smoke tests therefore left synthetic C01/C02 treatment records in the working-tree ledger even though the committed candidate-binding baseline still had all six pairs empty. The synthetic final-artifact hashes did not match the live C01 artifacts and were detected before any real C01 treatment was recorded or blind-scored.
a4_infrastructure_incidents.repair: Add an explicit --evaluation path to every state-mutating MTM-011 evaluation utility so tests can operate only on temporary ledgers; restore the working evaluation from the committed 237b7a3 zero-treatment baseline via the repository patch authority, then record C01 only from server-exported transition/report evidence and the actual finalized TeX files.
a4_infrastructure_incidents.scope_review: No frozen problem, pair order, metric, applicability flag, candidate SHA, A5 evidence, structural-primary threshold or release-gate rule changed. This is an evaluation-storage isolation fix only.

post_cutover_candidate_a5.purpose: Post-cutover binary A5 non-regression only; the frozen A/B acceptance remains bound to its original candidate and is not rewritten.

cutover_plan: Freeze and validate the MTM-011 corpus/evaluation contract.
Run all twelve paired treatments in frozen order and blind-score completed verified artifacts.
Run the deterministic aggregate gate and independent release gate.
Only after every gate passes, change the production new-run default from protocol 2 to protocol 3.
Build/install the versioned candidate, verify server_info/release-info/default behavior, and perform a real protocol-2 rollback/recutover drill.
rollback: Until cutover, no rollback is needed because protocol 2 remains the default. After cutover, restore protocol 2 as the new-run default without rewriting existing runs or verified artifacts.
manual_pending: Change only the new-run production default from protocol 2 to protocol 3 after this accepted qualification is committed; do not rewrite existing runs or historical MTM-009 evidence.
Build and install a versioned post-cutover candidate, verify default protocol 3 with MTM_WORKFLOW_PROTOCOL_VERSION unset, and preserve explicit protocol-2 selection as rollback.
Perform a real protocol-2 rollback and protocol-3 recutover drill before declaring MTM-011 complete.
